column3: NASB renders “was urging” as “was encouraging” and “watching without eating you continue” as “you have been constantly watching and going without eating.”
NASB follows the critical text; “exhort” is rendered “encourage.”
NASB follows the critical text (“we were”); “souls” is rendered “persons,” and “boat” is “ship.”
NASB renders “were lightening” as “began to lighten.”
NASB follows the critical text; “they were determining” is rendered “they resolved,” and “shore” is “beach.”
NASB renders “were making for” as “were heading for.”
NASB renders “a place between two seas” as “a reef where two seas met” and “violence” as “force.”
NASB renders “save” as “bring … safely through,” “hindered them of the purpose” as “kept them from their intention,” and “having cast themselves off” as “jump overboard.”
NASB adds “should follow” and renders “being saved” as “brought safely.”
